purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Jiaozuo Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau is the organizer of the Jiaozuo Tianditu web map and lists an “不动产办事大厅” (real-estate registration service hall). Henan’s official government-service catalog identifies the Jiaozuo city registration receiving window. These establish a local registry and public city map, but the map portal’s cache-miss route prevented inspection of its loaded layers or feature schema. Jiaozuo’s official city map lists public online-map functionality and is operated by the municipal natural-resources bureau, but the web reader returned “Cache miss” for the map shell and direct requests from the restricted environment failed DNS resolution. No layer catalog, parcel feature schema, safe native identifier field, or geometry-only route was verified. The city’s registry information is informational; no person/parcel query was made.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Jiaozuo municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau homepage lists the real-estate registration service hall and city services.
Official Jiaozuo Tianditu contact page identifies Jiaozuo Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as organizer and links the public online map at jzmap.gov.cn.
Public map-shell URL linked from Jiaozuo Tianditu; map page could not be fetched by the web reader (cache miss), and no layer/feature schema was verified.
Henan government-service guide gives the Jiaozuo municipal property-registration receiving window, location, and formal application workflow.

Official Henan procurement contract for Jiaozuo’s municipal registration center discusses city-level cadastral survey, real-estate-unit identifiers, spatial-data quality checks, and management of registration datasets; it is not a public geometry endpoint.
